verdict.rationale: PCI DSS scope reduction through tokenized card data is a fair question for a billing control layer like Autumn, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions tokenization, card-data handling, or PCI scope. References to Stripe subscriptions and a billing portal describe the host processor's role, not a documented Autumn capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my systems out of most of PCI DSS scope because card data is tokenized and never touches my servers
